title: Validation reliability and transferability of maternal risk classification across two public datasets
summary: A methodological investigation into how duplicate measurement profiles, evaluation design, and differences in source labels influence the interpretation of machine-learning performance in maternal risk classification.
contribution: Focuses on profile-grouped validation, limitations of cross-dataset comparisons, and the distinction between supplied risk labels and independently established clinical outcomes.
caveat: Under academic review and further verification. Not submitted, accepted, published, or clinically validated.
